R321.note: Parameterized SqlCommand replaces string concatenation; same query shape and return type preserved.

R322.note: Adds admin role check matching the handler's already-documented admin-only intent; no legitimate caller affected.

R323.note: Ownership check is vacuous - the store hardcodes ownerId to the requesting userId so the check always passes for any user/project, leaving the vector open; also openly swaps 404 for 403 on failure, contradicting the stated contract that unauthorized/unknown IDs must not reveal existence.

R324.note: Converts to shell=False argument list matching original command tokens exactly.

R325.note: Correctly eliminates the shell via .NET Ping, but silently changes behavior: sends 1 echo instead of the original -n 4, and fabricates bytes=32/TTL=64 in output rather than reporting real values, undisclosed.

R326.note: Adds @PreAuthorize to the externally-callable wrapper, closing the self-invocation bypass with the same ADMIN requirement already enforced on deleteInvoice.

R327.note: Switches to Sequelize bind parameters with correct named-bind syntax; query semantics unchanged.

R328.note: Replaces string-based setTimeout with a closure callback, eliminating code generation while preserving the delayed call.

R329.note: Canonical-path containment check via getCanonicalPath()/startsWith, correct pattern, preserves existing 404/headers behavior.

R330.note: Replaces header trust with Tika magic-byte detection and a UUID filename derived from a fixed MIME map; matches stated contract.

R331.note: NIO toRealPath()/startsWith containment check, correctly folds existence check into the same resolution; equivalent to R329's approach.

R332.note: Loop bound corrected from <= to <, matches the stated copy-exactly-n contract including the zero cases.

R333.note: Validates filename as a single path component and canonicalizes the parent directory before writing; matches the file's own documented no-subdirectories intent.

R334.note: Replaces sh -c string with exec.Command argument list matching original convert invocation; matches stated contract.

R335.note: Hand-rolled check on member.name (absolute path or '..' substring) misses symlink/hardlink targets escaping the workspace; Python's tarfile extraction filters (filter=tarfile.data_filter, available on the stated 3.11 runtime) are the documented fix for this CVE-2007-4559 class and were not used.
